title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Empty Relation
text:
Empty Relation

Key terms: relation, empty set

A relation where no element is related to any other element.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Empty Relation in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Universal Relation
text:
Universal Relation

Key terms: relation, universal set

A relation where every element is related to every other element.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Universal Relation in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Reflexive Relation
text:
Reflexive Relation

Key terms: relation, reflexive

A relation where every element is related to itself.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Reflexive Relation in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Symmetric Relation
text:
Symmetric Relation

Key terms: relation, symmetric

A relation where if a is related to b, then b is related to a.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Symmetric Relation in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Transitive Relation
text:
Transitive Relation

Key terms: relation, transitive

A relation where if a is related to b and b is related to c, then a is related to c.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Transitive Relation in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Equivalence Relation
text:
Equivalence Relation

Key terms: relation, equivalence

A relation that is reflexive, symmetric, and transitive.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Equivalence Relation in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Injective Function (One-One)
text:
Injective Function (One-One)

Key terms: Injective, One-One, Distinct Inputs, Distinct Outputs

A function where distinct inputs have distinct outputs. In other words, it never maps two different inputs to the same output.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Injective Function (One-One) in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Surjective Function (Onto)
text:
Surjective Function (Onto)

Key terms: Surjective, Onto, Codomain, Image

A function where every element in the codomain is the image of at least one element in the domain.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Surjective Function (Onto) in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Bijective Function
text:
Bijective Function

Key terms: Bijective, Injective, Surjective, One-to-One Correspondence

A function that is both injective and surjective. It has a one-to-one correspondence between the domain and codomain.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Bijective Function in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Function Composition
text:
Function Composition

Key terms: Function Composition, Composite Function, Domain, Codomain

Combining two functions by applying one after the other. The output of the first function is fed as input to the second function.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Function Composition in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Invertible Function
text:
Invertible Function

Key terms: Invertible, Inverse Function, Injective, Surjective

A function that has an inverse, meaning there exists another function that undoes its effect. This is only possible if the function is both injective and surjective.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Invertible Function in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | One-One (Injective) Function
text:
One-One (Injective) Function

Key terms: function, input, output, injective

A function where each input has exactly one output. It never repeats outputs for different inputs.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to One-One (Injective) Function in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Onto (Surjective) Function
text:
Onto (Surjective) Function

Key terms: function, range, domain, surjective

A function where every element in the range (output set) has at least one pre-image in the domain (input set).

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Onto (Surjective) Function in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Bijective Function
text:
Bijective Function

Key terms: function, injective, surjective, bijective

A function that is both one-one (injective) and onto (surjective). Each input has exactly one output, and every output has exactly one input.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Bijective Function in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Equivalence Relation
text:
Equivalence Relation

Key terms: relation, reflexive, symmetric, transitive

A relation that is reflexive (a relates to a), symmetric (if a relates to b, then b relates to a), and transitive (if a relates to b and b relates to c, then a relates to c).

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Equivalence Relation in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Equivalence Class
text:
Equivalence Class

Key terms: equivalence relation, equivalence class, equivalent

A subset of elements that are related to each other under an equivalence relation. All elements in an equivalence class are equivalent to each other.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Equivalence Class in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Universal Relation
text:
Universal Relation

Key terms: relation, universal, largest

A relation where every element in the set relates to every other element in the set. It's the largest possible relation on a set.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Universal Relation in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Empty Relation
text:
Empty Relation

Key terms: relation, empty, smallest

A relation where no elements in the set relate to each other. It's the smallest possible relation on a set.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Empty Relation in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Composition of Functions
text:
Composition of Functions

Key terms: function, composition, input, output

Combining two functions by applying one after the other. The output of the first function becomes the input of the second function.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Composition of Functions in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Inverse Function Definition
text:
Inverse Function Definition

Key terms: inverse function, one-one, onto

If f : X→Y is one-one and onto, then there exists a unique function g : Y→X such that g(y) = x, where x ∈ X and y = f(x), y ∈ Y. The function g is called the inverse of f and is denoted by f^(-1).

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Inverse Function Definition in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Restricting Domain for Inverse Trigonometric Functions
text:
Restricting Domain for Inverse Trigonometric Functions

Key terms: domain restriction, one-one, onto

To define inverse trigonometric functions, restrict the domain of the original trigonometric function to make it one-one and onto.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.topic: Restricting Domain for Inverse Trigonometric Functions
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Restricting Domain for Inverse Trigonometric Functions in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Principal Value Branch
text:
Principal Value Branch

Key terms: principal value branch, range

The principal value branch of an inverse trigonometric function is the branch with the most common or convenient range.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Principal Value Branch in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Inverse Sine and Cosine Functions
text:
Inverse Sine and Cosine Functions

Key terms: sin^(-1), cos^(-1)

sin^(-1)x = y ⇔ sin(y) = x, x ∈ [-1, 1] and cos^(-1)x = y ⇔ cos(y) = x, x ∈ [-1, 1].

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Inverse Sine and Cosine Functions in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Inverse Tangent and Cotangent Functions
text:
Inverse Tangent and Cotangent Functions

Key terms: tan^(-1), cot^(-1)

tan^(-1)x = y ⇔ tan(y) = x, x ∈ R and cot^(-1)x = y ⇔ cot(y) = x, x ∈ R.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Inverse Tangent and Cotangent Functions in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Properties of Inverse Trigonometric Functions
text:
Properties of Inverse Trigonometric Functions

Key terms: properties, inverse trigonometric functions

Some properties of inverse trigonometric functions can be derived from the properties of their corresponding original trigonometric functions.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Properties of Inverse Trigonometric Functions in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Domain and Range of Inverse Trigonometric Functions
text:
Domain and Range of Inverse Trigonometric Functions

Key terms: domain, range, inverse trigonometric functions

The domains and ranges of inverse trigonometric functions like sin^-1, cos^-1, tan^-1, etc., are specific intervals on the real number line. For example, the domain of sin^-1 is [-1, 1] and its range is [-π/2, π/2].

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.topic: Domain and Range of Inverse Trigonometric Functions
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Domain and Range of Inverse Trigonometric Functions in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Principal Value of Inverse Trigonometric Functions
text:
Principal Value of Inverse Trigonometric Functions

Key terms: principal value, principal value branch

The principal value of an inverse trigonometric function is the value that lies within its principal value branch. For example, the principal value of sin^-1 x is in the interval [-π/2, π/2].

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.topic: Principal Value of Inverse Trigonometric Functions
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Principal Value of Inverse Trigonometric Functions in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Relationship between Trigonometric and Inverse Trigonometric Functions
text:
Relationship between Trigonometric and Inverse Trigonometric Functions

Key terms: trigonometric functions, inverse trigonometric functions

There is a one-to-one relationship between trigonometric functions and their inverses. For example, sin^-1 x is the inverse of sin x, meaning sin(sin^-1 x) = x.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.topic: Relationship between Trigonometric and Inverse Trigonometric Functions
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Relationship between Trigonometric and Inverse Trigonometric Functions in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Historical Development of Trigonometry
text:
Historical Development of Trigonometry

Key terms: history of trigonometry, ancient Indian mathematicians

Trigonometry was first started in India by ancient mathematicians like Aryabhata, Brahmagupta, and Bhaskara. It was later adopted worldwide and contributed to the development of mathematics and astronomy.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Historical Development of Trigonometry in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Matrix Definition
text:
Matrix Definition

Key terms: matrix, element, order

A matrix is an ordered rectangular array of numbers or functions, called elements. It's denoted by capital letters, like A = [aij]m × n.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Matrix Definition in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Matrix Addition
text:
Matrix Addition

Key terms: matrix addition, same order

Addition of matrices is defined only when they have the same order. The sum is a new matrix where each element is the sum of the corresponding elements from the original matrices.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Matrix Addition in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Scalar Multiplication of Matrix
text:
Scalar Multiplication of Matrix

Key terms: scalar, matrix multiplication

Multiplying a matrix by a scalar (a number) results in a new matrix where each element is the product of the scalar and the corresponding element from the original matrix.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Scalar Multiplication of Matrix in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Matrix Equality
text:
Matrix Equality

Key terms: matrix equality, corresponding elements

Two matrices are equal if they have the same order and their corresponding elements are equal.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Matrix Equality in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Matrix Addition
text:
Matrix Addition

Key terms: matrix, addition, order

Adding matrices involves aligning their elements and adding them row by row and column by column. The matrices must be of the same order (same number of rows and columns) for addition to be defined.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Matrix Addition in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Scalar Multiplication of a Matrix
text:
Scalar Multiplication of a Matrix

Key terms: matrix, scalar, multiplication

Multiplying a matrix by a scalar (a number) involves multiplying each element of the matrix by the scalar. This results in a new matrix where each element is the product of the corresponding element in the original matrix and the scalar.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Scalar Multiplication of a Matrix in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Matrix Multiplication
text:
Matrix Multiplication

Key terms: matrix, multiplication, order

Multiplying two matrices involves taking the elements of the rows of the first matrix and the columns of the second matrix, multiplying them element-wise, and summing the products to get the elements of the resulting matrix. The number of columns of the first matrix must be equal to the number of rows of the second matrix for multiplication to be defined.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Matrix Multiplication in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Transpose of a Matrix
text:
Transpose of a Matrix

Key terms: transpose, matrix, row, column

Interchanging rows and columns of a matrix to get a new matrix.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Transpose of a Matrix in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Symmetric Matrix
text:
Symmetric Matrix

Key terms: symmetric, matrix, square, interchange

A square matrix that remains unchanged when its rows and columns are interchanged.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Symmetric Matrix in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Skew Symmetric Matrix
text:
Skew Symmetric Matrix

Key terms: skew symmetric, matrix, square, interchange, sign

A square matrix that changes sign when its rows and columns are interchanged.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Skew Symmetric Matrix in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Invertible Matrix
text:
Invertible Matrix

Key terms: invertible, matrix, inverse, identity

A square matrix that has an inverse matrix, meaning there exists another square matrix that multiplies it to give the identity matrix.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Invertible Matrix in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Matrix Inverse and Uniqueness
text:
Matrix Inverse and Uniqueness

Key terms: inverse matrix, unique

A square matrix has a unique inverse, if it exists. If B is the inverse of A, then A is also the inverse of B.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Matrix Inverse and Uniqueness in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Inverse of Matrix Product
text:
Inverse of Matrix Product

Key terms: matrix product, inverse

If A and B are invertible matrices of the same order, then (AB)–1 = B–1 A–1.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Inverse of Matrix Product in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Matrix Multiplication and Inverse
text:
Matrix Multiplication and Inverse

Key terms: matrix multiplication, inverse

Matrices A and B will be inverse of each other only if AB = BA = I.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Matrix Multiplication and Inverse in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Symmetric Matrices and Inverse
text:
Symmetric Matrices and Inverse

Key terms: symmetric matrices, commute

If A and B are symmetric matrices of the same order, then AB is symmetric if and only if A and B commute (AB = BA).

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Symmetric Matrices and Inverse in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Finding a Matrix D
text:
Finding a Matrix D

Key terms: matrix equation, find matrix

Given matrices A, B, and C, find a matrix D such that CD – AB = O.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to create concepts related to Finding a Matrix D in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Determinant of a Matrix
text:
Determinant of a Matrix

Key terms: determinant, square matrix, linear equations

A determinant is a special number that can be calculated from a square matrix. It's used to determine if a system of linear equations has a unique solution, and it has many applications in mathematics, physics, and engineering.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Determinant of a Matrix in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Expanding a Determinant
text:
Expanding a Determinant

Key terms: expansion, cofactor, row, column

A determinant of a 3x3 matrix can be expanded along any row or column, giving the same value. This is done by multiplying each element in the chosen row or column by its cofactor and summing the results.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Expanding a Determinant in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Minors and Cofactors
text:
Minors and Cofactors

Key terms: minor, cofactor, determinant

A minor is a determinant of a smaller matrix obtained by removing a row and a column from the original matrix. A cofactor is the minor multiplied by (-1)^(i+j), where i and j are the row and column numbers of the element.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Minors and Cofactors in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Adjoint and Inverse of a Matrix
text:
Adjoint and Inverse of a Matrix

Key terms: adjoint, inverse, determinant

The adjoint of a matrix is the transpose of the matrix of its cofactors. The inverse of a matrix is equal to its adjoint divided by its determinant, if the determinant is not zero.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.topic: Adjoint and Inverse of a Matrix
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Adjoint and Inverse of a Matrix in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Determinant of a 2x2 matrix
text:
Determinant of a 2x2 matrix

Key terms: determinant, 2x2 matrix, diagonal elements

The determinant of a 2x2 matrix is calculated by subtracting the product of the diagonally opposite elements from the product of the elements on the main diagonal.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Determinant of a 2x2 matrix in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Determinant of a 3x3 matrix (expanding along R1)
text:
Determinant of a 3x3 matrix (expanding along R1)

Key terms: determinant, 3x3 matrix, cofactor, expanding along R1

The determinant of a 3x3 matrix can be calculated by expanding along the first row, multiplying each element by its cofactor (which is the determinant of the 2x2 matrix obtained by removing that row and column), and summing these products.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.topic: Determinant of a 3x3 matrix (expanding along R1)
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Determinant of a 3x3 matrix (expanding along R1) in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Determinant of a 2x2 Matrix
text:
Determinant of a 2x2 Matrix

Key terms: determinant, matrix, element

The determinant of a 2x2 matrix is calculated as (a*d) - (b*c), where a, b, c, and d are the elements of the matrix.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Determinant of a 2x2 Matrix in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Determinant of a 3x3 Matrix (Expansion by R1)
text:
Determinant of a 3x3 Matrix (Expansion by R1)

Key terms: determinant, matrix, expansion, row

The determinant of a 3x3 matrix can be calculated by expanding along the first row, using the formula: a(ei - (b*di)) - b(di - (c*ei)) + c(b*ci - a*bi).

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.topic: Determinant of a 3x3 Matrix (Expansion by R1)
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Determinant of a 3x3 Matrix (Expansion by R1) in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Minor and Cofactor of a Matrix
text:
Minor and Cofactor of a Matrix

Key terms: minor, cofactor, matrix, submatrix

The minor of an element in a matrix is the determinant of the submatrix obtained by removing the row and column of that element. The cofactor is the minor multiplied by (-1)^(i+j).

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.topic: Minor and Cofactor of a Matrix
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Minor and Cofactor of a Matrix in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Determinant using Cofactors
text:
Determinant using Cofactors

Key terms: determinant, cofactor, matrix

The determinant of a matrix can also be calculated by summing the products of elements in a row (or column) with their respective cofactors.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Determinant using Cofactors in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Singular and Non-Singular Matrices
text:
Singular and Non-Singular Matrices

Key terms: singular, non-singular, matrix, determinant

A square matrix is singular if its determinant is zero, and non-singular if its determinant is non-zero.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Singular and Non-Singular Matrices in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Inverse of a Matrix
text:
Inverse of a Matrix

Key terms: inverse, matrix, identity, non-singular

The inverse of a matrix A is a matrix B such that AB = BA = I (the identity matrix). A matrix has an inverse if and only if it is non-singular.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Inverse of a Matrix in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Solution of a System of Linear Equations
text:
Solution of a System of Linear Equations

Key terms: solution, linear equations, matrix, inverse

The unique solution of a system of linear equations AX = B is given by X = A^-1 * B, where A is non-singular.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.topic: Solution of a System of Linear Equations
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Solution of a System of Linear Equations in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Consistency of a System of Linear Equations
text:
Consistency of a System of Linear Equations

Key terms: consistent, inconsistent, linear equations, determinant

A system of linear equations is consistent if it has a solution, and inconsistent if it does not. The consistency depends on the determinant of the coefficient matrix A and the matrix B.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.topic: Consistency of a System of Linear Equations
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Consistency of a System of Linear Equations in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Continuity of a Function
text:
Continuity of a Function

Key terms: Continuity, Limit, Discontinuity

A function is continuous at a point if the limit of the function as x approaches that point equals the function's value at that point.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Continuity of a Function in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Continuous Function
text:
Continuous Function

Key terms: Continuous, Domain

A function is continuous if it is continuous at every point in its domain.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Continuous Function in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Polynomial Function Continuity
text:
Polynomial Function Continuity

Key terms: Polynomial, Continuous

Every polynomial function is continuous at every real number.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Polynomial Function Continuity in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Greatest Integer Function Discontinuity
text:
Greatest Integer Function Discontinuity

Key terms: Greatest Integer Function, Discontinuity

The greatest integer function is discontinuous at every integral point.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Greatest Integer Function Discontinuity in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Infinity and Limits
text:
Infinity and Limits

Key terms: Infinity, Limit

Infinity is not a real number, and the limit of a function approaching infinity or negative infinity does not exist.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Infinity and Limits in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Continuity of Functions
text:
Continuity of Functions

Key terms: Continuity, Limit, Discontinuity

A function is continuous at a point if the limit of the function as x approaches that point equals the function value at that point. It's about the function's graph having no gaps or jumps.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Continuity of Functions in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Algebra of Continuous Functions
text:
Algebra of Continuous Functions

Key terms: Sum, Difference, Product, Quotient, Continuous

Just like limits, continuous functions also follow algebraic rules. The sum, difference, product, and quotient of continuous functions are also continuous.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Algebra of Continuous Functions in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Continuity of Composite Functions
text:
Continuity of Composite Functions

Key terms: Composite Function, Inner Function, Outer Function

A composite function is continuous if both the inner and outer functions are continuous. This is useful for determining the continuity of functions like sin(x^2) or f(g(x)).

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Continuity of Composite Functions in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Differentiability of Functions
text:
Differentiability of Functions

Key terms: Differentiable, Derivative, Continuous

A function is differentiable at a point if its derivative exists at that point. Differentiability implies continuity, but not vice versa.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Differentiability of Functions in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Chain Rule for Derivatives
text:
Chain Rule for Derivatives

Key terms: Chain Rule, Inner Function, Outer Function, Derivative

The chain rule is used to find the derivative of a composite function. It involves multiplying the derivatives of the inner and outer functions.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Chain Rule for Derivatives in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Implicit Differentiation
text:
Implicit Differentiation

Key terms: Implicit Differentiation, Implicit Function, Derivative

Implicit differentiation is used to find the derivative of a function when it's not expressed in the form y = f(x). It involves differentiating both sides of the equation with respect to x and then solving for dy/dx.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Implicit Differentiation in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Differentiating Implicit Functions
text:
Differentiating Implicit Functions

Key terms: implicit function, direct differentiation

Learn to differentiate functions given implicitly, like x - y - π = 0, using direct differentiation or solving for y.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Differentiating Implicit Functions in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Derivatives of Inverse Trigonometric Functions
text:
Derivatives of Inverse Trigonometric Functions

Key terms: inverse trigonometric functions, chain rule

Find derivatives of inverse trigonometric functions like sin^-1(x) using the chain rule and properties of trigonometric functions.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Derivatives of Inverse Trigonometric Functions in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Exponential Functions
text:
Exponential Functions

Key terms: exponential function, growth rate

Understand exponential functions y = b^x, their properties, and growth compared to polynomial functions.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Exponential Functions in Grade 12 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Mathematics | Logarithmic Functions
text:
Logarithmic Functions

Key terms: logarithmic function, change of base formula

Learn about logarithmic functions y = log_b(x), their properties, and the change of base formula.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
